name: credential-usage-monthly
description: Month-to-date usage of lent reasoning credentials per borrower tenant and credential (tokens, estimated cost), refreshed daily so the 80% budget notice and the 100% stop notice reach the owner early. Reads the execution-metrics rows the metering funnel stamps with credential_ref; writes nothing but ops alerts.

_refs.cli: pnpm kyberion reasoning credentials usage --tenant <tenant> [--month YYYY-MM]
